units.observed: Staff compare phone/desktop hotel page with brochure and actual room picture. Modern layouts and blank booking controls support website information/navigation review; no SEO ranking claim.
units.currentJapaneseLessonComparison: navigation/information/booking: readable room/access/booking information and consistent actual facility offer.

units.observed: Staff inspect garden post on smartphone and consult local partner with calendar and regional brochure. No unlicensed guest-photo repost or fabricated engagement metric shown.
units.currentJapaneseLessonComparison: content/local/ugc/analysis: accurate local cooperation, permission-aware content and inspect response before changing approach.

units.observed: Staff demonstrate straight-back bow in mirror with supervisor observing. No exact generated angle markings; native15/30/45 geometry remains authoritative.
units.currentJapaneseLessonComparison: posture/bow: words before bow, posture from hips, approximate angles linked to situation.

units.observed: Guest points to desired date; staff listens and records, then discusses record with supervisor in second scene. No promise before verification is indicated.
units.currentJapaneseLessonComparison: request/honorific: listen, consider possible response and consult supervisor; exact honorific examples remain native text.

units.observed: Staff walks ahead to guest left, looks back and uses open palm; guest follows at short distance. Both face same forward corridor direction.
units.currentJapaneseLessonComparison: walk/objects: left-front guidance and matching pace; two-to-three-step distance is a written approximate guide, not a pixel measurement.

units.observed: Staff sits facing wheelchair guest at comparable eye level while guest expresses a preference toward dining area. No unasked physical handling or universal near-seat instruction.
units.currentJapaneseLessonComparison: eye/seat/application: ask personal needs and seat preference; native A/B diagram carries practice geography.

units.observed: Receptionist has pen and notebook ready during call; second scene visibly hands report to supervisor. No unauthorized compensation or immediate hang-up shown.
units.currentJapaneseLessonComparison: phone/transfer/complaint/limit: memo readiness and responsible report after listening/confirmation.

units.observed: Housekeeping presents found watch on tray while receptionist records and supervisor indicates storage case. No disposal deadline or unverified return to a claimant shown.
units.currentJapaneseLessonComparison: s03/s04: record characteristics/discovery and preserve handoff; actual applicable procedure must be checked.

units.observed: Staff compare guest-facing booking screens with internal room-status table and brochure. Generic unlabeled screen shapes do not claim a particular PMS integration.
units.currentJapaneseLessonComparison: pms/engine/channels/commission: distinguish guest entry channels/internal operations; real contract/integration conditions still need confirmation.

New material-v2 preserves occupational scene, adds dimensional cloth/skin/wood and fine line detail.
units.currentJapaneseLessonComparison: calculation/profit: exact50room A/B revenue metrics remain native guide; no generated numeric formula or profit implication.
